name: Explosive Consultation
summary: In Westfall, Sprite Jumpsprocket sends a volatile charge to Alba Fairmoon. The primed explosives must reach her safely, with the detonator undisturbed.

sections.title: A Volatile Delivery
sections.body: Sprite Jumpsprocket has finished a bundle of Extra-Destructive Explosives for Alba Fairmoon. In wartime Westfall, the road is already threatened by Defias bandits and feral beasts. Carrying a live charge makes the journey more dangerous.

sections.title: Handling with Care
sections.body: Sprite Jumpsprocket warns you to guard the detonator. The explosives are meant to destroy the hidden industrial operation in the Deadmines, which is poisoning Westfall's farmland. Alba Fairmoon needs the explosives intact before she can use them.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Explosive Consultation?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket, a gnome tinkerer in Stormwind's Dwarven District, gives you the explosives to carry.

faq.q: Who receives the explosives at the end of the quest?
aliases: where do i take the explosives
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon in Westfall receives the Extra-Destructive Explosives.

faq.q: What item are you tasked with transporting?
faq.answer: You carry a package of Extra-Destructive Explosives with a primed, delicate detonator.

faq.q: Why are explosives needed in Westfall?
aliases: why blow things up in westfall
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon traced the toxins poisoning Westfall's farmland to a massive industrial operation hidden in the Deadmines. She sought an engineer to supply explosives capable of destroying it.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: No. Sprite Jumpsprocket and Alba Fairmoon support Alliance operations, so only Alliance adventurers can take this on.

faq.q: Does Sprite Jumpsprocket warn you about any specific danger?
faq.answer: Sprite Jumpsprocket warns that the bomb is primed and tells you to handle the detonator with extreme care on the journey.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know gnomish ordnance brings high yield and a hair-trigger detonator.
As a gnome, you see Sprite Jumpsprocket bring Gnomeregan's explosive solutions to Westfall's troubled front.
As an Alliance adventurer, you see operatives across Westfall use unconventional arms against entrenched bandit camps and rogue machinery.
